title: Requirements register
description: The full list of requirements, extracted line by line from the project brief and expanded into the engineering obligations each one implies. Status is deliberately conservative: nothing is 'delivered' unless the artefact exists in this branch and is linked. 'Blocked' means the requirement cannot be satisfied by an agent — it needs a decision, a data licence or money, and those are the owner's to give.

columns.label: Where it lives / what is missing

rows.requirement: Collect, organize and analyse using a full list of requirements.
rows.acceptance: A machine-readable register exists; every requirement has an owner, a status and an acceptance test.
rows.delivered: data/requirements.json (this file) plus the Requirements page on the site.
rows.no_source_reason: Requirement restated from the owner's brief; its source is the instruction, not an external document. Verification applies to the deliverable, linked in `delivered`.

rows.requirement: Suggestions to improve the site's decision-making, with a dedicated section a human can review before implementing anything.
rows.acceptance: Every suggestion carries impact, effort, risk, dependency and an open decision field the owner can set to accept / reject / defer.
rows.delivered: data/suggestions.json + Suggestions page. No suggestion has been implemented on the site except those the brief itself mandated.
rows.no_source_reason: Requirement restated from the owner's brief; its source is the instruction, not an external document. Verification applies to the deliverable, linked in `delivered`.

rows.requirement: A clear list of questions, information and answers needed before any decision can reasonably be made, based on what we have and do not have.
rows.acceptance: Each question states why it blocks a decision, what is known with source, what is missing, how to obtain it, and the default if it stays unanswered.
rows.delivered: data/questions.json — 24 questions, 15 of them blocking.
rows.no_source_reason: Requirement restated from the owner's brief; its source is the instruction, not an external document. Verification applies to the deliverable, linked in `delivered`.

rows.requirement: Suggestions must be made to discover missing information.
rows.acceptance: Each gap has a discovery action (a source to open, a report to buy, a field to log), not just a complaint.
rows.delivered: data/missing_data.json — 18 named gaps, each with an acquisition path and a blocker class.
rows.no_source_reason: Requirement restated from the owner's brief; its source is the instruction, not an external document. Verification applies to the deliverable, linked in `delivered`.

rows.requirement: Originate our own NFL lines.
rows.acceptance: A documented model produces a total and a spread per game from non-market inputs, with an explicit release cadence and no coefficient presented as validated until it is.
rows.delivered: data/models.json + Methodology page. Blocked by R-31 (line history) and R-32 (drive-level history); coefficients are specified as estimable, not estimated.

rows.requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals.
rows.acceptance: Each candidate signal is stated as a hypothesis with a falsifiable threshold, a market, and a gate set to survive.
rows.delivered: data/models.json signal inventory SIG-01…SIG-14 — none may be claimed 'useful' until it passes validation.

rows.requirement: Treat strategy development as a leaderboard competition that rewards top-performing strategies.
rows.acceptance: Ranking is computed on a luck-adjusted statistic, entries are sealed, and prize governance carries a legal caveat.
rows.delivered: data/leaderboard.json + Leaderboard page + engine/leaderboard.py which computes ranks from a bet log.

rows.requirement: Cover single bets: spread, total, money line.
rows.acceptance: Pricing, edge, staking and settlement rules defined for each; break-even hurdle computed, not quoted from memory.
rows.delivered: engine/pricing.py derives break-even 52.38% at -110 from first principles, cross-checked against the note in SRC-015.

rows.requirement: Cover parlays.
rows.acceptance: Parlay value is computed on the operator's combined price with a correlation correction, and correlated legs are refused or repriced per house rules.
rows.delivered: engine/correlation.py + Correlation page; rules traced to regulator-hosted house rules.

rows.requirement: Cover player-prop bet combos.
rows.acceptance: Prop-combo dependency graph defined (QB yards vs WR catches vs team totals) with explicit do-not-combine lists and a Monte-Carlo joint pricing path.
rows.delivered: data/correlations.json (15 pairs, every rho left blank until measured) + engine/correlation.py joint simulator.

rows.requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates.
rows.acceptance: Gates are numeric, ordered, and a strategy that trips a hard gate cannot be promoted regardless of profit.
rows.delivered: data/validation_gates.json G-1…G-13 + engine/gates.py producing a PASS/FAIL row per strategy from a bet log.

rows.requirement: Determine correlation values.
rows.acceptance: Correlations measured from a joint outcome sample we own or license, with stated estimator, bootstrap CI and sample size — never asserted from intuition.
rows.delivered: Table published with every rho blank and flagged. Measurement needs historical scores plus lines: scores are derivable from official results, lines are not free.

rows.requirement: Remove luck from the equation; build strategies that are selectively skill-based.
rows.acceptance: Ranking uses a lower confidence bound on expected value; a strategy is only 'selective' if it abstains by rule; required sample sizes are published even when uncomfortable.
rows.delivered: engine/stats.py (Wilson interval, bootstrap, power analysis) + Validation page. The power analysis is the honest headline: distinguishing a 55.0% true hit rate from the 52.38% break-even at 80% power requires 2,243 settled bets, and a 150-bet season can only prove roughly a 62.4% hit rate — which is why selective must mean few large-edge bets, not many small edges.

rows.requirement: The system should track injuries.
rows.acceptance: Weekly ingestion of the official report with change-diffs by timestamp; blank fields stay blank; no fabricated P(play).
rows.delivered: engine/injuries.py parses a captured snapshot (data/injury_snapshot.json) and diffs it. The live fetcher is specified but cannot run inside this sandbox, which has no outbound access to nfl.com — recorded as a blocker, not hidden.

rows.requirement: Know deficiencies in defences when 2nd, 3rd or 4th-string backups replace starters.
rows.acceptance: A next-man-up index per defensive group built from official roster/availability data, with the quality gap estimated in-house and labelled as an estimate.
rows.delivered: data/injury_model.json — NMU index definition; group weights remain parameters to fit, not constants.

rows.requirement: The same for offences using starters or backups.
rows.acceptance: Offence-side index with a separate QB branch (QB1/QB2/QB3), because the quarterback case dominates every other position.
rows.delivered: data/injury_model.json. Note: 'Will QB start?' is a league-prohibited market, so QB availability may be an input but never a wager of its own.

rows.requirement: Executive summary outlining important details.
rows.acceptance: One page: what exists, what is missing, the moves that unblock the most, and the hard risks — using no number that is not in the registers.
rows.delivered: EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md + Executive Summary page, generated from the same JSON so it cannot drift from the data.

rows.acceptance: Build, verify, PR and Pages deploy all run from scripts/agents; the owner is asked nothing.

rows.acceptance: Every register renders as a table and the analysis text lives in a column of the row it analyses, so a row cannot be read without its reasoning.

rows.acceptance: The verifier fails the build if a row lacks a resolvable source id, or if a source id is absent from the register.
rows.delivered: site/verify.py rules R4 and R5 — the build cannot ship an unsourced table row.

rows.requirement: If a value cannot be confirmed from an official source, leave it blank and flag it unverified; never infer or fill in.
rows.acceptance: Blank plus UNVERIFIED badge for every unconfirmable value: all 15 correlation coefficients, every model coefficient, every Nevada hold figure.
rows.delivered: Enforced by verify.py rule R6: a numeric value sitting next to an unverified flag breaks the build.

rows.acceptance: Board exists, claims pushed, sibling sessions discovered and recorded, conflicts resolved without discarding their work.
rows.delivered: COORDINATION.md — four sessions found on the remote, scope split recorded, merge plan logged.

rows.requirement: Compliance: no wagers the league prohibits, no non-public information.
rows.acceptance: A hard exclusion list in code, sourced to the league's own published framework, checked at bet-slip generation time.
rows.delivered: engine/compliance.py implements the four prohibited classes published at media.nfl.com/lsb and refuses to emit such a bet.

rows.requirement: Responsible-gambling posture for a tool that informs staking.
rows.acceptance: Help resource on every page; staking caps default below full Kelly; the tool states plainly that most bettors lose.
rows.delivered: Site footer plus engine/pricing.py defaulting to fractional Kelly with an exposure cap; SRC-019 records that Kelly maximises log-growth, not safety.

rows.requirement: Historical opening and closing lines for backtesting and CLV.
rows.acceptance: A licensed or purchased source with point-in-time guarantees and a documented snapshot time.
rows.delivered: No free official source exists; the league's data is distributed exclusively (SRC-020). This is the single highest-value purchase in the programme.

rows.requirement: Drive-level and play-level history for totals origination and next-man-up estimation.
rows.acceptance: Own-licensed or self-collected game logs with a schema; snap counts and coverage alignments need a licensed NGS feed.
rows.delivered: Specified in data/missing_data.json GAP-04 and GAP-05. Without it the deficiency model can only assume a league-average replacement — a known-weak assumption we publish rather than bury.

rows.requirement: Automated nightly and weekly ingestion with no manual step.
rows.acceptance: Scheduler, idempotent collector, alert on schema drift, raw snapshots retained for audit.
rows.delivered: Cannot execute from this sandbox (only github and package registries are reachable). The collector is written and unit-tested against a captured fixture; the deployment target is an open item, Q-19.
rows.no_source_reason: Requirement restated from the owner's brief; its source is the instruction, not an external document. Verification applies to the deliverable, linked in `delivered`.

rows.requirement: Leaderboard rewards must not create an unlawful prize promotion.
rows.acceptance: No purchase and no entry fee, skill-based ranking documented, published rules, eligibility by jurisdiction, tax handling.
rows.delivered: Design constraints recorded in leaderboard.json under 'legal'. We do not opine on legality; this is flagged, not solved.

rows.requirement: Siblings' work must be integrated, re-verified, and not silently overwritten.
rows.acceptance: A merge commit on the integration branch, their files preserved, their content re-checked, any defect raised as a flag rather than deleted.
rows.delivered: Three sibling branches found; merge and re-verification recorded in COORDINATION.md.

rows.requirement: Selectivity rule: bet only when our number beats the market by a stated margin.
rows.acceptance: One tunable edge threshold in config, with its effect on bet volume and required sample size published together.
rows.delivered: engine/gates.py G-4 plus models.json policy.edge_threshold; the trade-off curve is computed, not asserted.

rows.requirement: Weather, venue, rest and travel effects.
rows.acceptance: Each feature has a named official source and a documented lag; no feature enters the model without one.
rows.delivered: Rest and short-week effects are derivable from the official schedule and are specified. The weather source (NOAA/NWS) was not verified in this pass, so it is recorded as gap GAP-07 and not used as a feature.

rows.requirement: Model versioning, sealed submissions, auditability of every decision.
rows.acceptance: Strategy identity = code hash + config hash + data hash; ranks recomputable from stored bet logs.
rows.delivered: engine/leaderboard.py hashes entries; COORDINATION.md is the decision log.

rows.requirement: In-game and live betting explicitly in or out of scope.
rows.acceptance: A recorded decision with a reason.
rows.delivered: Recommended out for v1: latency, Watch & Bet video rights and in-play data all sit behind the exclusive distributor (SRC-020) and live hold is the widest in the book. Recorded as a recommendation, not assumed as a decision.

rows.requirement: Licence, .gitignore, reproducible build, no secrets.
rows.acceptance: Files exist and the build script runs clean.
rows.delivered: LICENSE (MIT), .gitignore, site/build.py, site/verify.py added by this session. Their absence at HEAD was recorded as irregularities F-2 and F-3 in COORDINATION.md.
